projects.title: Mr. Chi MAOAO Restaurant & Coast Bar
projects.subtitle: Urban Heat Island (UHI) & Autodesk Forma Microclimate Analysis
projects.summary: Practical thesis investigation on Urban Heat Island (UHI) mitigation along the coastal landscape. Integrating thermal imaging drone observation with Autodesk Forma early-stage solar radiation and wind simulations. The white reflecting canopy geometry and aerodynamic corridors mitigate heat absorption while framing sea horizons.

details.concept: Analyzing thermal radiation stark contrast between rock surfaces (34.1°C) and shaded vegetative corridors (<28.9°C). Autodesk Forma solar hour simulations guided the roof curvature to shelter visitors from extreme noon exposure while inviting prevailing coastal sea breezes through winding corridors.
details.materials: High-albedo white roof membranes, local basalt aggregate concrete, low-E operable double glazing, salt-resistant timber louvers.
details.awards: Special Topics on Professional Practices: Urban Heat Island in Taipei (Advisor: Dr. Lucky S.J. Tsaih)

projects.title: Zhongshan CURVED Youth Hostel
projects.subtitle: Wave-form Urban Facade & Community Permeability
projects.summary: A 7-story urban boutique youth hostel defined by sculptural, wave-like cantilevered balconies that generate dynamic street rhythms. The ground floor dissolves into a public courtyard and community cafe, fostering spontaneous encounters between international travelers and local neighborhood residents.

details.concept: The continuous sinuous floorplates serve as passive solar sunshades for the guest rooms, reducing summer cooling requirements while offering private green micro-terraces facing the city tree canopies.
details.materials: Architectural fair-faced white concrete, acoustic double-glazed window assemblies, vertical greenery planter boxes, custom modular timber bunk joinery.
details.awards: Design Studio III Project 113 • Selected for Departmental Exhibition

projects.title: BIM-to-BEM Interoperability & EnergyPlus Calibration
projects.subtitle: Automated gbXML Thermal Validation Pipeline & Optimization
projects.summary: Graduate research resolving geometric distortion and thermal zoning disconnects between Autodesk Revit and EnergyPlus. Implemented an automated gbXML validation workflow slashing topological error to below 5%, coupled with NSGA-II genetic algorithms to balance sDA/ASE daylighting against cooling energy.

details.concept: Bridging architectural BIM and thermal simulation (BEM). By scripting automated Revit API analytical space boundaries, the framework resolves non-manifold surface geometry prior to EnergyPlus simulation.
details.materials: Autodesk Revit API, EnergyPlus, Python, gbXML Schema, NSGA-II Multi-Objective Optimization.
details.awards: 15%–25% Simulated Building Energy Savings | Benchmarked to LEED EAc2 & Taiwan BERS
